svg.title: 31. Lying inward hip turn — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Lie on your back with one leg straight. Bend the other knee and place its foot slightly outside that hip. Let the bent knee move inwards a small distance while your pelvis stays still.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://covenanthealth.ca/locations/misericordia-community-hospital/osteoporosis-program/osteoporosis-program-guide/flexibility
